name: Gyōson
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 66); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1135.

poems.title: In lonely solitude I dwell
poems.author: Gyōson
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 66

poems.title: 66. 諸共に あはれと思へ 山ざくら (Morotomo ni aware to omoe yamazakura)
poems.author: Gyōson
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 金葉集
poems.text:
諸共に あはれと思へ 山ざくら
花よりほかに 知る人もなし
